title: OTR voice reference bank entry
description: One castable voice reference (plan E.1). The deterministic caster scores entries by gender/timbre/role/age and picks exactly one per slot from a seeded RNG. Identity is voice_ref_id (I-9 keys on this, never the character name).

voice_ref_id.description: Stable identity of this voice reference. The cast lock stamps this onto a slot; downstream selects, never re-casts (I-4/I-9).

engine.description: Audio engine name this reference is for (must be a registered engine in the audio-engine registry).

timbre.description: Caster timbre tags (weight 40). May be empty.

roles.description: Audio roles this voice can serve, e.g. char_voice / announcer_voice.

age_band.description: Caster age-band match field (weight 10), e.g. child / young_adult / adult / elder.

ref_path.description: Path to the reference audio clip on local disk (VALIDATE_INPUTS checks local-disk presence).

ref_sha256.description: sha256 of the reference clip for integrity + re-baseline tracking (voice_bank_id+sha is a re-baseline trigger).

commercial_clean.description: I-8 three-state input at the bank layer: true = clean, false = known-gated (non-blocking warning). A missing value is fail-closed at the release gate, not here.

quality_tier.description: Whiny-fix P2b ADDITIVE curation field, stamped by the operator's blind audition reel: 'a' (lead-grade) / 'b' (minor-role grade) / 'reject' (never cast). Absent/empty = not yet audited; behavior unchanged.

style_tags.description: Whiny-fix P2b ADDITIVE curation tags, e.g. lead_safe / nasal_risk. Consumed by the deterministic tier pre-filter (filter_by_quality_tier); never reweights scores.

provider_voice_id.description: Cloud-audio campaign 2026-07-03 (C3) ADDITIVE: the provider's own voice identifier (e.g. ElevenLabs voice_id) for cloud (partner-node) engines. Threaded end-to-end so cloud casting resolves from adapter metadata, not a disk sentinel. Empty/absent for every local (ref-clip/preset) engine.
